verdict.rationale: The product is itself a documented public REST API. It has getting-started docs with curl examples, per-endpoint API reference pages (web, local POIs, rich search, suggestions, spell check, answers, LLM context), API-key onboarding, an OpenAI-SDK-compatible answers endpoint, and a live llms.txt confirmed by probe. Community threads note that AI-inference use requires the dedicated AI plan rather than the free tier, which is a licensing caveat rather than a gap in the API. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404).
